references.text: The prohibition against divination and interpreting omens is repeated here, where the Lord forbids the Israelites from practicing such pagan customs.
The warning against seeking out mediums and spiritists, as this makes one unclean before the Lord.
The Lord will turn against those who seek out mediums and spiritists and cut them off from the people.
The immediate context lists the specific detestable practices of the nations, including divination, interpreting omens, and sorcery.
Isaiah's irony toward Babylon and their many sorcerers and star-gazers who cannot save them.
A warning against listening to prophets, spiritists, and dream interpreters who speak false words.
The seers will be put to shame and the diviners blush, because God does not answer them.
Simon, who practiced sorcery in Samaria, an example of pagan practice that stands in contrast to God's power.
